sections.heading: Create practice opportunities
sections.content: Look for “pickup games”: low-barrier, low-risk opportunities to work with others on problems. Idiodi suggests volunteering with a nonprofit team or helping with a community event or church activity. The key is collaborative problem-solving—the kind of work product teams do—and getting repeated reps. He emphasizes that mastery doesn’t come from avoiding the work; practice lets you stop, get feedback, and make corrections before the “game-time” moments of product management.

sections.heading: Learn by observing strong teams
sections.content: Seek environments where good product work and coaching are visible. Idiodi points to repeated good outcomes—such as winning teams or great products—as signs that good coaching or leadership may be present. Observe how people work, then try and practice what you learn; seeing good work helps you do it and eventually teach it.

answer.summary: Without a good coach, Idiodi recommends finding low-risk practice arenas for collaborative problem-solving, getting repeated reps, and observing teams that produce good outcomes so you can learn from how they work.

sections.heading: Create practice opportunities
sections.content: Product management is a “game-time” role, so don’t wait for work assignments to be your only practice. Idiodi suggests joining low-barrier, low-risk “pickup games”: volunteer with a nonprofit team, help with a community or church event, or find other settings where people solve problems collaboratively. Get repeated reps working with others; practice lets people stop, make corrections, and give feedback.

sections.heading: Learn by observing good work
sections.content: Look for environments where you can see good product work and coaching in action. Idiodi says repeated good outcomes—such as winning teams and great products—are an indication of good coaching. Observe how people work, then try those approaches yourself; he describes this as seeing, doing, and eventually being able to teach good product work.
